task_prompt: Quantum computing task: Implement the 3-qubit bit-flip code in Qiskit with dynamic circuits: encode RY(2.018)|0>, apply an X error on qubit 2, extract the syndrome with two ancillas, correct with if_test, and verify the decoded statistics over 4096 shots.
